output.summary: The function fn_11 computes a value based on the input bytes and returns it. It does not modify the input or output buffers and does not use any external libraries or global state.

claims.text: A loop iterates over the input bytes.
The loop condition checks if the current pointer has reached the end of the input.
The loop body updates the result by adding the current byte to the product of the result and 0x29.
Returns 0x1d35 when the input length is zero.
Returns the computed value when the input length is non-zero.
Does not modify the input buffer.
